newsitem.title: USA: VSI Enterprises holders file class action.
newsitem.headline: VSI Enterprises holders file class action.

text.p: VSI Enterprises Inc was named in a class-action lawsuit filed against the company by a group of its shareholders, the law firm representing the shareholders said on Friday.

The firm -- Lowey Dannenberg Bemporad & Selinger in White Plains, N.Y., said it filed the class action in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia on behalf of investors seeking to "recover damages".

It said investors who bought common stock between October 6, 1995 and January 8, 1996, or redeemed Class B warrants between October 6, 1995 and December 18, 1995, allege that the company misrepresented or omitted information about its expected revenues and profits for the fourth quarter and year ended December 1995.
A spokesman for the company, which designs and makes systems for video conferences, said he was not aware of the class action and declined to comment.
